title: Operation Dark Gold
tagline: After being expelled from the police academy, Yan Mingyu goes undercover inside
synopsis: After being expelled from the police academy, Yan Mingyu goes undercover inside his biological father Mai Zhongwei's Tianyao Group to investigate a major money laundering case. As he gains the organization's trust, he uncovers a conspiracy linking organized crime, corrupt officials, and the truth behind his mother's death.
